shelters.description: Ferret rescue organization serving the Maine coast. Takes in surrendered and abandoned ferrets for rehabilitation and adoption.

shelters.name: MDI Pet Food Pantry
shelters.description: Pet food pantry located in Bar Harbor Food Pantry. Provides pet food assistance to families in need on Mount Desert Island.

shelters.name: Sullivan Animal Food Eatery
shelters.description: Pet food pantry open Mon-Thurs 8-4, Friday 8am-12pm. Provides pet food assistance at Sullivan Town Office in Hancock County.

shelters.name: The Pet Place Pantry
shelters.address: North Yarmouth Congregational Church, 3 Gray Road
shelters.description: Pet food pantry open second Saturday of each month from 9-10am for curbside pickup. Provides pet food assistance in Cumberland County.

shelters.description: Online platform where individuals and rescue groups can post animals for adoption free. Covers all species including dogs, cats, birds, horses, and exotics in Maine.

shelters.name: Embrace A Vet Maine

notes: Comprehensive collection of Maine animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, rescue organizations, wildlife rehabilitation centers, equine rescues, farm sanctuaries, and spay/neuter clinics. Includes both municipal shelters and nonprofit rescue organizations across the state from Portland to Aroostook County. Notable organizations include Peace Ridge Sanctuary (GFAS-accredited, 2024 Outstanding Sanctuary of the Year), Avian Haven (largest avian rehab in New England, 34,000+ birds treated), and Center for Wildlife (90,000+ animals over 39 years). Many foster-based rescues transport dogs from southern high-kill shelters.
